name: github-repo-to-x-threads
description: Responsible technical-source to Agent-engineering X content skill bundle with brand routing, model quality chain, evidence review, reusable assets, image governance, optional official X API publishing, and strategy memory.

github_token.description: Optional GitHub token for live metadata collection.

grok_api_key.description: Optional xAI/Grok API key for pre-publish semantic evaluation.

x_oauth2_access_token.description: Optional OAuth2 user token for explicitly approved official X API publishing.

contracts.claimSafety: Separate verified facts, live metadata, inference, and user vision.
contracts.imageGovernance: Actual generated images are the default for final packs and must be registered in images_manifest.json.
contracts.publishing: Manual-safe by default; live publishing uses only official X API after explicit user approval.
contracts.brandFit: Main-account content maps to Agent reliability, build-in-public, paper-to-system, or embodied AI watch, with one reusable asset and one concrete discussion question.
contracts.qualityChain: Generated packs expose source grounding, brand lane, angle tournament, asset design, draft synthesis, adversarial review, and final gate.
